result.instructions: Tools for Sentry, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which unresolved issues in our production project were seen most often this week?"; "Show me the newest event of issue 4512 with its stack trace."; "Resolve the checkout timeout issue and assign it to team 45.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Sentry data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sentry_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sentry_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sentry_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. sentry_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sentry_list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List the organizations this token can access, with their slugs. Start here to get the organization slug the other tools need. Sentry API: GET /organizations/.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.

tools.name: sentry_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the projects of an organization, with slug, id, platform and team. Sentry API: GET /organizations/{org}/projects/.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.

tools.name: sentry_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: Get one project with its platform, teams and settings. Sentry API: GET /projects/{org}/{project}/.

project.description: Project slug or numeric id, from sentry_list_projects.

tools.name: sentry_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List the teams of an organization. Sentry API: GET /organizations/{org}/teams/.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.

tools.name: sentry_list_issues
tools.title: List issues
tools.description: List the issues (grouped errors) of an organization. Filter with the Sentry search query, for example is:unresolved. Sort: date (default), new, freq, user, trends or inbox. Sentry API: GET /organizations/{org}/issues/.

query.description: Sentry search query, for example 'is:unresolved level:error'.

project.description: Numeric project ids to include, from sentry_list_projects.

statsPeriod.description: Relative time window, for example 24h or 14d.

sort.description: Sort order: date, new, freq, user, trends or inbox.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.

tools.name: sentry_get_issue
tools.title: Get an issue
tools.description: Get one issue with its title, culprit, status, assignee, counts and first and last seen times. Sentry API: GET /organizations/{org}/issues/{issue_id}/.

tools.name: sentry_list_issue_events
tools.title: List an issue's events
tools.description: List the events (single occurrences) of one issue. Set full to true to include the stack trace and tags. Sentry API: GET /organizations/{org}/issues/{issue_id}/events/.

full.description: Include the full event payload (stack trace, tags, context).

statsPeriod.description: Relative time window, for example 24h or 14d.

query.description: Sentry search query, for example 'is:unresolved level:error'.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.

tools.name: sentry_get_event
tools.title: Get an event
tools.description: Get one event by id with its stack trace, tags, contexts and breadcrumbs. Sentry API: GET /projects/{org}/{project}/events/{event_id}/.

project.description: Project slug or numeric id, from sentry_list_projects.

event_id.description: Event id (32 hex characters), from sentry_list_issue_events.

tools.name: sentry_query_events
tools.title: Query events (table)
tools.description: Run an explore query that returns a table of aggregated events, for example count per issue or p95 duration per transaction. dataset: errors (default), logs, spans, profile_functions, tracemetrics or uptime_results. Sentry API: GET /organizations/{org}/events/.

field.description: Columns, for example issue, count(), p95(span.duration).

query.description: Sentry search query, for example 'is:unresolved level:error'.

statsPeriod.description: Relative time window, for example 24h or 14d.

sort.description: A column from field, prefixed with - for descending.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.

tools.name: sentry_list_releases
tools.title: List releases
tools.description: List releases of an organization, newest first, with version, dates, commit count and new issues. Sentry API: GET /organizations/{org}/releases/.

project.description: Numeric project id to filter by, from sentry_list_projects.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of the release version, for example 1.4.2.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.

tools.name: sentry_get_release
tools.title: Get a release
tools.description: Get one release by version with its commit count and new issue count. Sentry API: GET /organizations/{org}/releases/{version}/.

tools.name: sentry_update_issue
tools.title: Update an issue
tools.description: Change an issue's status (resolved, unresolved, ignored, resolvedInNextRelease or muted), its assignee (for example user:123 or team:45) or its bookmark. Only the fields you pass change. Sentry API: PUT /organizations/{org}/issues/{issue_id}/.

assigned_to.description: Actor to assign, for example user:123 or team:45.

is_bookmarked.description: Bookmark the issue or remove the bookmark.
